sloka: प्रदातुम् तव काकुत्थ्स सदृअशः त्वम् हि पार्थिव ।कामम् बहुगुणाः सर्वे त्वयि एते न अत्र संशयः ॥१-२२-१९॥
transliteration: pradātum tava kākutthsa sadṛaśaḥ tvam hi pārthiva ।kāmam bahuguṇāḥ sarve tvayi ete na atra saṁśayaḥ ॥1-22-19॥

translations.english: You possess all these qualities in great measure. There is no doubt that If these two sciences (mantras) are nourished with austerities they will assume multiple forms (and benefit you)".
